layout.longCopy: split at natural speech/meaning boundaries; do not omit words or silently shrink until unreadable

productionProfile.themeColorPolicy: explicit per-style palette; never apply a global theme color over every caption; inspect skin, floor and dark-clothing backgrounds

motionBoundsPolicy.bounds: union of complete animated glyph bounds, strokes, shadows, glows, chromatic split, skew, scale and translation
motionBoundsPolicy.innerComposition: keep settled text dimensions and transform origin; compensate outer asset placement to preserve settled center
motionBoundsPolicy.avoid: do not crop motion to the small settled box or use a fixed transparent timeline-size wrapper
